description:
Navigate to the Money activity in GCompris and complete 3 rounds of counting. 

1. Create a directory for evidence at `~/Documents/money_evidence/`.
2. From the GCompris main menu, find and open the 'Money' activity (look for coin/bill imagery, often under Discovery or Math categories).
3. Take a screenshot of the open activity and save it as `~/Documents/money_evidence/activity_opened.png`.
4. Complete at least 3 rounds of the exercise (drag coins/bills to match the price).
5. After completing rounds, take a progress screenshot saved as `~/Documents/money_evidence/rounds_completed.png`.
6. Return to the main menu and take a final screenshot saved as `~/Documents/money_evidence/main_menu_return.png`.
